queries: WITH g AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS n_tel FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mu FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_bw) AS avg_of_kept_avgs, SUM(g.n_tel) AS total_telescopes, AVG(g.avg_bw - m.mu) AS avg_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE g.avg_bw > m.mu

assumptions.assumption: The telescope count per phase counts every matched telescope, including those with a missing bandusagepct. Only the average ignores missing values.

The mean of all phase averages is the unweighted mean across phases, with each phase counted once. A phase whose telescopes all have missing bandwidth has no average, so it is left out of that mean and cannot be kept.

assumptions.assumption: A missing moon phase means a NULL lunarstage, which GROUP BY treats as its own group. Empty strings are not treated as missing.
The number of telescopes in a phase counts every matched telescope, including those with NULL bandusagepct. Those telescopes are left out of the average only.
A phase whose telescopes all have NULL bandwidth has a NULL average. It is left out of the mean of phase averages and cannot be kept.
